adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) returns nil it enqueues Jobs::RetrieveTopic and renders the 'loading' template. app/views/embed/loading.html.erb unconditionally reloads the page every 30s via setTimeout(document.location.reload(), 30000). If the background retrieval can never create a TopicEmbed (e.g., TopicRetriever#fetch_http returns early when SiteSetting.embed_by_username user is missing, or other retrieval failures), the embed URL will continue to have no topic_id and the client will loop reload indefinitely with no terminal/error state.
